00f9511f function FormatCounter(Format, Counter)
00f95149 	if(!Counter)
00f9515a 		return '0';

00f9520e 			{
00f95213 				return '?';
00f95223 			}
00f9522f 	var str = Negative ? '-' :'' ;

00f952b3 			if (Seperate)

00f952f2 			for (var i = 0; Counter && i < 3; ++i)
00f9531c 			{
00f95321 				var Digit = Math.floor(Counter % 10);

00f9538d 			}
00f95397 		for(var i = 0; i < result.length; ++i)
